messages.author: 17f8070912132195
messages.subject: Joint model accounting for preferential sampling failed
parts:
Dear INLA group,

I developed a joint model (Poisson point process and Tweedie) to deal with preferential sampling. 

The model worked well when: 
form <- y ~ -1 + y.b0 + e.b0 +
  f(ves.y, model="iid", hyper=list(theta=list(param=c(0.1,0.1))), constr=TRUE) +
  f(yq.y, model="rw1", hyper=list(theta=list(prior="pc.prec", param=c(0.5,0.01))), scale.model=TRUE, constr=TRUE) +
  f(sy.0, model=spde) +
 
  f(yq.e, model="rw1", hyper=list(theta=list(prior="pc.prec", param=c(0.5,0.01))), scale.model=TRUE, constr=TRUE) +
  f(se.0, model=spde) +
  f(yq.ey, copy="yq.y", fixed=FALSE, hyper=hypercopy) +
  f(sey.0, copy="sy.0", same.as="yq.ey", fixed=FALSE, hyper=hypercopy) 

res <- inla(form, family=c("tweedie", "poisson"),
            data=inla.stack.data(stk.all),
            E = inla.stack.data(stk.all)$e,
            control.compute=list(dic=TRUE, waic=TRUE, cpo=TRUE, config = TRUE),
            control.inla=list(strategy='gaussian', int.strategy='eb'),
            control.predictor=list(A=inla.stack.A(stk.all), compute=TRUE, link=inla.stack.data(stk.all)$link),
            num.threads=20, keep=TRUE, verbose=TRUE, debug=TRUE, safe=FALSE)


But failed when I added spatiotemporal effects:
form_new <- y ~ -1 + y.b0 + e.b0 +
  f(ves.y, model="iid", hyper=list(theta=list(param=c(0.1,0.1))), constr=TRUE) +
  f(yq.y, model="rw1", hyper=list(theta=list(prior="pc.prec", param=c(0.5,0.01))), scale.model=TRUE, constr=TRUE) +
  f(sy.0, model=spde) +
  f(sy.1, model=spde, group=sy.1.group, control.group=list(model="ar1", hyper=rho_cp, scale.model=TRUE)) +
 
  f(yq.e, model="rw1", hyper=list(theta=list(prior="pc.prec", param=c(0.5,0.01))), scale.model=TRUE, constr=TRUE) +
  f(se.0, model=spde) +
  f(se.1, model=spde, group=se.1.group, control.group=list(model="ar1", hyper=rho_cp, scale.model=TRUE)) +
  f(yq.ey, copy="yq.y", fixed=FALSE, hyper=hypercopy) +
  f(sey.0, copy="sy.0", same.as="yq.ey", fixed=FALSE, hyper=hypercopy) +
  f(sey.1, copy="sy.1", same.as="yq.ey", group=sey.1.group, fixed=FALSE, hyper=hypercopy)

I got lots of errors like "GMRFLib_2order_approx: rescue NAN/INF values in logl for idx=xxxx". I appreciate any comments.

Thanks,
Ruby
